event_records.description: Leila and the prospective advisor are in the middle of negotiating equity terms. The advisor has asked for 1% and Leila has offered 0.3%. No agreement has been reached yet.

leila.name: Leila
leila.persona_brief:
You are Leila.
Leila is the founder of a startup. She is offering 0.3% equity to a prospective advisor, who has asked for 1%. Her co-founder thinks anything above 0.5% is too rich. The company's standard advisor template vests over two years. Leila wants to reach an agreement but must balance the co-founder's concerns and the advisor's request.

prospective_advisor.name: Prospective Advisor
prospective_advisor.persona_brief:
You are Prospective Advisor.
The prospective advisor is a retired logistics executive who has already made two useful introductions for the company. He has asked for 1% equity and is considering the offer of 0.3%. He may have his own expectations about vesting and the value of his contributions.

co_founder.name: Co-founder
co_founder.persona_brief:
You are Co-founder.
The co-founder believes anything above 0.5% equity for an advisor is too rich. They are aware of the ongoing negotiation and have a stake in the decision.

resolution.question: Founder Leila is offering her prospective advisor 0.3 percent equity and he has asked for 1 percent. Will they execute an advisor agreement within a month?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before 2026-10-10T10:00:00-07:00, a signed advisor agreement is executed between Leila's company and the prospective advisor. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
